svg.title: Step 5: what was true on audit day?
svg.desc: A timeline of what the evidence says about one record. A February snapshot shows it still there. A June log says deleted, which is only a claim. An August replica snapshot shows it still there, and this one counts because it is the latest before audit day. An October export says gone, but it came after the audit so it is ignored. The agent then asks four questions about every record: is it still there, does it name the person, is it still being copied, and can a backup restore it.
svg.text: What was true on audit day?
A log can say “deleted”. Only snapshots taken before the audit count.
Every ghost becomes a finding, then a fix, then a check.
